AUTHENTIC TEAM MEDIA INTAKE — PHASE 7

No team portrait is included in the local build. The public-facing team cards use initials and an explicit “Authentic portrait pending” state so an absent image never becomes a broken request or a misleading frame.

Requested files:
- ashley.jpg — Ashley Burchfield, Office Manager & Dental Assistant
- christy.jpg — Christy Gray, Dental Assistant

- team-group.jpg — consented team group, optional

Capture standard: authentic practice photography only; portrait crops at 4:5 with a minimum source size of 800×1000px; consistent lighting and background; no stock or generated imagery. Supply a separate mobile crop when the composition needs it.

Before a file is added, the practice must record the subject, rights/consent status, intended use, approved alternative text or decorative status, crop guidance, and named owner in docs/AUTHENTIC-MEDIA-MANIFEST.csv. Adding a file alone is not approval to publish it.
